diagram_math_checks.check: Degree-reduction Definition steps 2–3 and def-constraint-graph-regularization give 128 internal slots plus one external slot per port: 129. The overlay adds 128 slots and 65 ordinary loops, each contributing two slots, giving 129+128+130=387. Thus the undirected paired-slot count is (2m)*387/2=387m ordinary edges. These are symbolic degree counts, not degrees inferred from the deliberately incomplete schematic.
